name: Vampire Valentine
source:
A game where you meet a vampire in his cave.

Play it to uncover other things about this vampire and choose whether you want to romance him, in Vampire Valentine. 

[From [url=https://starsintheskysam.itch.io/vampire-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
